laws.rule: Gran Paradiso National Park: dogs on a lead are permitted only in valley-bottom areas and, from 15 July to 15 September, on certain paths shown in the park maps. Other areas are closed to dogs; check the route-specific map.
Gran Paradiso National Park: free camping outside equipped areas is prohibited. A one-night Alpine emergency bivouac is allowed when no shelter serves the area or available shelters are full.

Piedmont regional guidance says wild mushroom collectors generally need a personal collection entitlement represented by a payment receipt; specified low-commercial-value species and some accompanied children are exempt. Carry the receipt and identity document, and check protected-area rules.

laws.rule: Piedmont regional guidance sets a general maximum of three kilograms of mushrooms per person per day, requires suitable open containers that disperse spores, and bans plastic bags. Rules for some property rights holders differ.
